sentences.text:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Kumar
 For the Petitioner : Mr. Amritansh Vats, Adv.
 For the State : Mr. Saket Kumar, A.P.P.

For the O.P. No.2 : Mr. Yogesh Modi, Adv.
 ....

1.  The applicant-husband who is in custody since 30.09.2022 has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Putki P.S. Case No.48 of 2018, corresponding to G.R. No.2124 of 2018, registered for the offence under Sections 498A/ 323 of IPC and Sections 3/4 of the D.P. Act.
2.
It has been submitted by both the parties that it is a matrimonial dispute and there is a chance of settlement.

Considering the nature of dispute between the parties and with a view to save the matrimonial home, the applicant, named above, is directed to be released on provisional bail for four months, on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/- (Ten thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned J.M.1st Class, Dhanbad in connection with Putki P.S. Case No.48 of 2018, corresponding to G.R. No.2124 of 2018, subject to the conditions that the applicant will submit self-attested copy of his Aadhaar Card and also give his mobile number before the learned court below which he will not change during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.
Both the parties are directed to appear before the Secretary, JHALSA, Ranchi on 02.08.2023.
The Secretary, JHALSA, Ranchi will try to explore the possibility of settlement of dispute and will submit a report to this Court.
